envelope.literal_request: Allow manual API key entry and connection with Bol for internal Bol integration management and additional client accounts, where every new account and credential produces a new scanner tab.
envelope.intended_outcome: The production Ampere scanner provides an authenticated in-product workflow to add or rotate Bol Retailer client credentials, validates and encrypts them server-side, gives every connected account a stable correctly labelled tab, and preserves account-qualified fail-closed scanning without revealing secrets.

outcomes.text: An authenticated operator can list, add, and update Bol Retailer connections using account name, client ID, client secret, and warehouse-password re-authentication; nothing is saved until Bol token, orders, and shipments access succeeds.

Credential pairs are encrypted at rest with a dedicated server-only AES-256-GCM key and account-bound authenticated data, never returned or stored in browser state, and every mutation is audited without secret material.

Existing Bankhoes and Muisstil environment accounts remain stable fallbacks/identities, database records may safely override their credentials, and every new account receives a stable dynamic source key and labelled scanner tab used end-to-end for retailer reads, live scan verification, and provenance.

The additive ampere-only migration, full server/browser behavior, approved Turso/Vercel/GitHub release, and current desktop/mobile production outcome are verified without accessing an unapproved third live Bol account.

envelope.unacceptable_narrow_interpretation: A browser-only credential form, plaintext storage, another fixed environment slot, UI-only dynamic tabs, token-only validation, unaudited secret updates, source keys derived from mutable labels, or a release that requires submitting credentials for an unapproved account.
in_scope: Authenticated list/add/update connection manager with exact actionable states and dynamic tabs.
Dedicated encryption configuration, AES-GCM vault, database-backed account registry, environment fallback/override behavior, and duplicate client identity prevention.
Same-origin session-protected and warehouse-password re-authenticated API mutations; live token/orders/shipments validation before atomic save/audit.
Dynamic account resolution through retailer reads, snapshots, scan verification, and non-secret provenance while preserving FIFO and aggregate fail-closed behavior.
Additive ampere-only migration, tests, approved release, API/schema/browser proof, and visual/adoption receipts.
out_of_scope: Account deletion/disabling, credential reveal/export, roles or a new admin password, and historical provenance backfill.
Bol Ads API, retailer writes, account settings, intermediary OAuth, customer-data display, or provider account discovery.
Non-ampere Bankhoes data, unrelated GitHub/Vercel projects or accounts, and live use of an unnamed/unapproved third Bol account.
Changing aggregate complete-snapshot policy to per-account partial availability.
acceptance_evidence: Unit/application tests prove exact key validation, session and re-auth controls, live-validation-before-write, AES-GCM integrity/AAD, duplicate/no-write behavior, static fallback/override, dynamic key resolution, and no-secret outputs.
Fresh and pre-003 local migration plus approved live ampere schema/ledger/readback prove additive account/audit/provenance storage without non-ampere access.
Browser tests prove list/add/update/pending/success/rejected/expired states, NL/EN/ES copy, dynamic tab creation, account-qualified scans, keyboard/focus, and responsive containment.

Exact approved Vercel identity, non-disclosed key-name configuration, Git commit, READY deployment, authenticated metadata API, existing approved account tabs, and validated current desktop/mobile visual/adoption receipts.
envelope.dependency_expansion_rule: Only an inspected causal dependency from an OUT item may become required; deletion, role redesign, per-account partial snapshots, and other provider surfaces remain excluded.

target.cross_root_authority_reason: The project context and target implementation root are identical.

plan_manifest.draft_text:
# Reviewed plan

1. Add a compact authenticated Bol-connections dialog to the existing scanner. It lists only non-secret account metadata, offers Add account and Update credentials, requires account name where applicable plus client ID, client secret, and current warehouse password, renders actionable loading/success/rejected/duplicate/unavailable/session-expired states, pauses scanner focus while open, and dynamically reconciles one labelled tab per returned account in NL/EN/ES. Deletion and secret reveal remain excluded.
2. Add a strict dedicated `BOL_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` configuration and server-only AES-256-GCM vault. Encode one credential-pair JSON payload per account with a random 96-bit nonce, authentication tag, versioned account-key AAD, and keyed client-ID fingerprint. Reject malformed keys/envelopes, tampering, wrong-account AAD, control characters, and all browser/response/log paths for credential or token material.
3. Add a database-backed Bol account service that merges fixed `primary`/Bankhoes and optional `secondary`/Muisstil environment fallbacks with encrypted database overrides. Generate opaque stable `acct_*` keys for new accounts, keep labels separate from identity, limit account count/name/credential sizes, prevent duplicate fingerprints, and cache clients only by current encrypted-record revision. Before any write, instantiate a candidate client and require successful OAuth token plus sanitized orders page 1 and shipments page 1 reads.
4. Add an authenticated `/api/integrations` route: GET returns non-secret account metadata; POST creates; PUT replaces credentials/label for a named existing key. Mutations enforce same origin, exact body keys, active session, and a fresh warehouse-password check. Commit encrypted row plus non-secret create/update audit atomically only after Bol validation. Map rejected credentials, duplicate identity, re-auth failure, database/config, and upstream availability to bounded user-actionable errors without raw bodies.
5. Make retailer and scan account resolution async and dynamic. Preserve account-qualified snapshot/detail/live verification, FIFO/automatic focus, global collision detection, and aggregate complete-snapshot fail-close. Validate dynamic source keys server-side; persist exact source identity only for source-qualified decisions and retain null for unknown/unverified source-less codes.
6. Add numbered ledgered migration `003` creating only `ampere_bol_accounts`, its indexes, and `ampere_bol_account_audit`, plus nullable unconstrained dynamic `source_account_key` columns on package state/events. Read `COALESCE(source_account_key, source_account)` for legacy compatibility; write the legacy column only for primary/secondary and the new column for every source. Do not backfill or touch non-ampere data.
7. Add crypto, service, repository, application, config, scan, migration, secret-hygiene, and browser coverage. Prove create/update/no-write failure, duplicate/race fail-close, environment fallback/override, stable label/key separation, dynamic retailer/scan provenance, forged keys, session expiry, all UI states/locales, keyboard/focus, responsive containment, and unchanged FIFO/partial-data behavior. Run contract validators, local migration twice, pre-003 upgrade, full server/browser suites, and diff/secret checks.
8. Confirm the approved Vercel identity; create a dedicated random encryption key without printing it and set only that key name/value in Preview and Production. Apply the additive `003` migration only to the approved Bankhoes Turso `ampere_*` namespace, commit/push/deploy the intended branch, and verify exact deployment, migration/schema/ledger, authenticated non-secret account metadata, existing Bankhoes/Muisstil tabs, and current desktop/mobile manager/tab/focus/console states. Do not submit credentials for an unapproved third live Bol account; synthetic end-to-end tests prove the creation path. Create and validate deployment/source visual receipts and the adoption manifest.

steps.text: Implement the authenticated management dialog, truthful interface states, and dynamic labelled tabs without exposing secrets or disrupting scanner focus/FIFO.
Add dedicated encryption configuration and an account-bound AES-256-GCM credential vault with keyed duplicate fingerprinting and strict secret boundaries.
Add a dynamic Bol account service with environment fallbacks, encrypted overrides, opaque stable keys, duplicate prevention, live token/orders/shipments validation, and revision-bound client caching.

Add the protected integrations route and make retailer/scan resolution async and dynamic while preserving same-origin auth, fresh password re-authentication, FIFO, global collision detection, and fail-closed outcomes.
Add a ledgered additive ampere-only migration for encrypted account/audit records and dynamic source-key provenance with legacy compatibility and no backfill.
Add focused and full server/browser/migration/security coverage for every secret, identity, failure, state, interaction, and compatibility edge.

Configure the dedicated encryption key only in the approved Vercel project, migrate only approved ampere objects, commit/push/deploy, and verify exact schema/API/browser/visual outcomes without a third live account write.
